name: md-tiers
description: Claude manages this project's markdown files in two tiers: instructions (CLAUDE.md, skills, settings, hooks, memory: changed only when asked or when the code they describe changes; usage of the project's own scripts is written there so their bodies are never re-read), free low-priority know-how (promoted to instructions once it proves useful). When a task is done and builds and tests pass, Claude commits only its own edits from that chat. All per project, with a contamination cleanup on first use.
